verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's documented public Marketing API has a 'Send a Mailchimp campaign' endpoint, and the API is described as powering marketing campaigns from your app. Scheduling appears only in a reference to RSS campaigns sending on their schedule. The pack does not show the create-campaign or schedule endpoints for regular campaigns, so the full no-dashboard workflow is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: an explicit create-campaign endpoint, an explicit schedule-campaign endpoint for regular campaigns, campaign content setup via API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
